📎 Gmail Attachment to Google Drive Gmail Attachment to Google Drive Download Gmail Attachment and upload to Google Drive Tool • 7 Pull email attachments straight into Google Drive — no copy-paste, no downloads, no manual filing. This tool searches your Gmail inbox using a query you provide, finds the first matching email with an attachment, downloads that attachment, and uploads it to a Google Drive folder of your choice. It runs as a single step in your agents or workflows, so any time you'd otherwise be forwarding emails to yourself, saving files to Downloads, and dragging them into Drive — you can replace that whole loop with one tool call. It uses Gmail's full search syntax (the same operators you'd type into the Gmail search bar), so you can find emails by sender, subject phrase, label, date range, file type, or even by RFC Message-ID if you already know it. Examples that work out of the box: from:billing@acme.com subject:"invoice" has:attachment newer_than:7d filename:pdf label:contracts older_than:30d rfc822msgid:CALXBSm...@mail.gmail.com The destination is just as flexible. Pass a Google Drive folder ID and the file lands there with its original filename and MIME type intact. Leave it blank and it goes to the root of My Drive. Folder IDs are easy to grab — they're the bit after /folders/ in any Drive URL. Common use cases Invoice / receipt automation — agents triage finance emails and file attachments into the right Drive folder Contract & document intake — when a signed contract lands in a shared inbox, route it straight to the legal folder Resume collection — pull CVs out of recruiting inboxes and into a candidate folder for the team Customer onboarding — collect logos, brand assets, or signed forms from welcome emails and stage them for delivery Personal inbox cleanup — point an agent at your inbox once a week to file PDFs, statements, and receipts where they belong Alex Waite Free

📎 Gmail Attachment to Google Drive Gmail Attachment to Google Drive Download Gmail Attachment and upload to Google Drive Tool • 7 Pull email attachments straight into Google Drive — no copy-paste, no downloads, no manual filing. This tool searches your Gmail inbox using a query you provide, finds the first matching email with an attachment, downloads that attachment, and uploads it to a Google Drive folder of your choice. It runs as a single step in your agents or workflows, so any time you'd otherwise be forwarding emails to yourself, saving files to Downloads, and dragging them into Drive — you can replace that whole loop with one tool call. It uses Gmail's full search syntax (the same operators you'd type into the Gmail search bar), so you can find emails by sender, subject phrase, label, date range, file type, or even by RFC Message-ID if you already know it. Examples that work out of the box: from:billing@acme.com subject:"invoice" has:attachment newer_than:7d filename:pdf label:contracts older_than:30d rfc822msgid:CALXBSm...@mail.gmail.com The destination is just as flexible. Pass a Google Drive folder ID and the file lands there with its original filename and MIME type intact. Leave it blank and it goes to the root of My Drive. Folder IDs are easy to grab — they're the bit after /folders/ in any Drive URL. Common use cases Invoice / receipt automation — agents triage finance emails and file attachments into the right Drive folder Contract & document intake — when a signed contract lands in a shared inbox, route it straight to the legal folder Resume collection — pull CVs out of recruiting inboxes and into a candidate folder for the team Customer onboarding — collect logos, brand assets, or signed forms from welcome emails and stage them for delivery Personal inbox cleanup — point an agent at your inbox once a week to file PDFs, statements, and receipts where they belong Alex Waite Free
